note: a two period hold removes most of the churn and costs a fraction of a period of delay on the moves that are real. That is a good trade and it is not a free one, which is the reason to measure both columns. What it does not do is make the classification right: the items whose class is noise are still assigned a class, and the hold only stops that assignment changing every quarter
